integrity: A self-contained proof and standalone exhaustive finite checker are supplied; finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple paths, strictly positive symmetric additive edge values, complete endpoint allocations, and zero-inclusive (all-removals) EFX. Exponential loss applies to coherent strictly increasing perturbations, not all perturbations. Published-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp EFX orientation entropy on weighted paths and its collapse under monotone perturbations
